title: Generative vs. Encoder Large Language Models for ASR Evaluation: A Comparative Study
abstract: arXiv:2608.25574v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) is typically evaluated using Word Error Rate (WER), which poorly reflects semantic similarity. While embedding-based metrics correlate better with human judgments, the respective roles of encoder and decoder-based Large Language Models (LLMs) remain underexplored. This paper presents a comparative study of both families for ASR evaluation. We analyze BERTScore and SemDist across different LLMs, layers, and pooling strategies, showing that both metrics can achieve strong correlation with human judgments when properly configured. For decoder models, we investigate generative LLMs in two settings: pairwise hypothesis selection via prompting and direct qualitative error classification. Our results show that encoder-based metrics remain highly competitive, while generative LLMs perform strongly in hypothesis comparison and improve the interpretability of ASR evaluation.

translated_title: 生成式与编码器大型语言模型在自动语音识别评估中的比较研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25574v1 公告类型：新 摘要：自动语音识别（ASR）通常使用词错误率（WER）进行评估，这难以反映语义相似性。尽管基于嵌入的度量与人工判断的相关性更好，但编码器和解码器基础的大型语言模型（LLMs）各自的作用仍未充分探索。本文对这两类模型在ASR评估中的表现进行了比较研究。我们分析了不同LLMs、层和池化策略下的BERTScore和SemDist，结果表明，当适当配置时，这两种度量都能与人工判断达到强相关性。对于解码器模型，我们研究了生成式LLMs在两种设置下的表现：通过提示进行成对假设选择和直接定性错误分类。我们的结果显示，基于编码器的度量仍然高度竞争性，而生成式LLMs在假设比较中表现强劲，并提高了ASR评估的可解释性。
tldr: 本文通过比较编码器和生成式大型语言模型在ASR评估中的表现，发现编码器度量仍具竞争力，而生成式LLMs在假设比较和错误分类中增强了评估的可解释性。
en_tdlr: This paper compares encoder and generative large language models for ASR evaluation, finding encoder metrics remain competitive while generative LLMs enhance interpretability in hypothesis comparison and error classification.
